info.title: RunningApp API
info.description: Backend for an athlete-focused social platform (DO -> LOG -> SHOW). See docs/FRONTEND_INTEGRATION.md.

timezone.description: IANA zone the activity took place in.

splits.description: Populated by the detail views (GET /activities/{id}, create, import); null in lists and feeds.

hasRoute.description: A route exists AND some of it may be shown to this viewer.

routePreview.description: Simplified (<=120 points), privacy-filtered route for cards. Fetch /route for detail.

ownerPrivacy.description: Present only when the viewer owns the activity.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null when there are no more items.

value.description: Seconds for FASTEST_*/LONGEST_DURATION, metres for distances/climbs.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null when there are no more items.

verified.description: True only when platform staff have verified this creator.

contactEmail.description: Public business contact, if the creator chose to publish one.

DerivedSpeed.description: Computed from average speed (distance / moving time). All null when speed is unknown.

installId.description: Stable random id generated once per app install (persist it in secure storage).

path.description: Dotted path to the offending field, e.g. "caption" or "metrics.avgHeartRateBpm".

requestId.description: Echo of the X-Request-Id header; quote it in bug reports.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null when there are no more items.

FollowResult.description: FOLLOWING for public accounts; REQUESTED for private accounts awaiting approval.

available.description: False when the server has no credentials for this provider configured.

isMinor.description: Under the adult age; stricter privacy defaults apply.

deletion.description: Non-null while the account is scheduled for deletion.

PrivacyZone.description: Visible to the owner only. Route points inside a zone are never shown to anyone else.

isPrivate.description: Private accounts show a lock and require follow approval.

segments.description: Encoded polylines (Google format, precision 5). Usually one; several when parts of the route were hidden (privacy zones / trimmed ends). Draw each separately; never join them.

bbox.description: Bounding box of the SEGMENTS SHOWN (not of the raw track).

isPrivacyFiltered.description: True when some of the original route is withheld from this viewer.

discoverable.description: Appear in search and "who to follow".

personalizationEnabled.description: When false, behaviour is not used to personalise the feed.

speedDisplay.description: How to present the primary speed metric for this sport.

supports.description: Which metrics are meaningful. Supplying an unsupported metric is rejected (METRIC_NOT_SUPPORTED_FOR_SPORT); omitting any metric is always fine.

refreshToken.description: Opaque, single-use. Exchange via POST /v1/auth/refresh; store only in secure storage.

isPrivate.description: Private accounts show a lock and require follow approval.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null when there are no more items.

relationship.description: Viewer -> this user. REQUESTED = follow request pending.

hasPendingRequestFromThem.description: This user asked to follow the viewer and awaits approval.

post.summary: Create an account and sign in
post.description: Returns tokens immediately. Users under the adult age get private-by-default settings. A verification email is sent; until verified, publishing is blocked (`EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED`) when the server enforces it.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Repeated failures for one email are progressively throttled (`RATE_LIMITED` with `Retry-After`). Accounts scheduled for deletion can sign in (restricted mode) so they can cancel.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair
post.description: Refresh tokens are single-use and rotate on every call. Re-presenting a used token revokes the whole session (`REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED`). Clients must serialise refresh calls (the provided api-client does).

post.summary: Revoke every session on every device
Confirm an email address with the emailed token
Send a new verification email (max one per minute)

post.description: Always answers 202 regardless of whether the email is registered, so it cannot be used to discover accounts.

post.summary: Set a new password using the emailed token
post.description: Revokes every session of the account.

post.summary: Change password (signs out all other sessions)

get.summary: List active sessions (devices) for the account
Check whether a username can be registered

post.description: The account is hidden immediately and permanently deleted after the grace period (default 30 days). Other sessions are revoked; this session stays in restricted mode so the user can cancel. Signing in also works in restricted mode.

get.summary: The signed-in account: identity, profile, settings, deletion state
get.description: Works for suspended and pending-deletion accounts so clients can show the right screen.

patch.summary: Update display name, bio, username, location label, primary sport
patch.description: Changing to a *different* username is limited to once per 14 days (`USERNAME_CHANGE_COOLDOWN`).
Switching `accountVisibility` PRIVATE -> PUBLIC approves all pending follow requests. Users under the public-account age cannot select PUBLIC (`PUBLIC_ACCOUNT_NOT_ALLOWED`).

get.description: Anonymous access is allowed. Blocked pairs, suspended and pending-deletion accounts all return `USER_NOT_FOUND`. Private accounts return the header and counts; their posts are visible only to approved followers.

post.description: Metrics are all optional; supplying one the sport does not support is rejected with `METRIC_NOT_SUPPORTED_FOR_SPORT`. Units are SI (metres, seconds, m/s). When `createPost` is true (default: your `autoCreateActivityPost` setting) a feed post is created for the activity.

title.description: Defaults to e.g. "Morning Run" from the local start time.

timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. "America/Los_Angeles". Defaults to UTC.

createPost.description: Create a feed post for this activity. Defaults to your `autoCreateActivityPost` setting.

post.summary: Import a GPX file as an activity
post.description: Send the raw GPX XML as the request body with `Content-Type: application/gpx+xml` (max 10 MB). Distance, moving time, elevation, kilometre splits and heart rate are derived from the track; every point must carry a <time>. Importing the same file twice is idempotent and returns the existing activity (200).

get.description: Not-visible and non-existent activities are indistinguishable (`ACTIVITY_NOT_FOUND`). Routes are privacy-filtered for everyone but the owner.

patch.summary: Edit title, description, visibility, route privacy
patch.description: Only the owner. Measurements are immutable once logged.

delete.summary: Delete an activity (and its route and auto-generated feed post)

get.summary: The activity route as encoded polyline segments
get.description: Owners get the real route (or, with `view=PUBLIC`, a preview of exactly what others see). Everyone else gets the privacy-transformed route: ends trimmed, privacy zones removed, optionally coarsened. 404 when there is nothing to show.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Owners may request PUBLIC to preview exactly what other people see. Non-owners always get PUBLIC.
